svg.aria-label: 04. SolarKon. Live. The website of a solar energy company: its services, projects, a product store and financing, with an admin panel where the team edits every page themselves. Role: Web developer, freelance. Built: Company website, product store, admin panel. Stack: Laravel, PHP, Inertia, React, Tailwind CSS.
